description: This file contains functions related to managing system paths, specifically for retrieving content and CA certificates paths within the starboard common namespace. It includes functions to get paths from subdirectories, prepend content paths, and fallback mechanisms for path retrieval.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPathFromSubdir
methods.description: Constructs the path to CA certificates based on a subdirectory within the content directory.

methods.name: PrependContentPath
methods.description: Prepends the system content directory path to a given relative path.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPath
methods.description: Retrieves the CA certificates path, trying a specific subdirectory first, then falling back to the default content path.

methods.name: GetCACertificatesPath
methods.description: Provides the CA certificates path, with fallback logic if the primary path does not exist.
